note: The fixed icon rig (WP-P0-12): every icon is rendered with this camera, these lights and these settings. Distances and light sizes are in units of the subject's bounding radius, so the light on a 5 cm seed packet and a 60 cm plank stack is the same; light power is given for a 1 m distance and scales with the square of the real distance.

camera.note: pitch = src/contracts/look.js CAMERA.pitchDeg (the game camera); the subject turns, the camera never does. fill = the share of the frame the subject's projected bounds take along their longer side: 0.66, calibrated so that measured like the source (docs/art/icons/review-stats.json: object segmented from its slot) ours match the source's median object size / slot side (0.65-0.69 over 13 native icons, WP-P0-12 review 1), so the 64 and 128 px files sit 1:1 in 1x1 and 2x2 slots with the corners free

color.note: Khronos PBR Neutral keeps printed label colours at their authored values up to the highlights (AgX drifts saturated reds towards salmon), which is how the source's inventory icons read; icons are UI images, drawn without the game's AgX + LUT chain

shadow.note: the source's soft contact shadow below-right of every icon (about 7 codes darker than the slot on all 13 measured source icons): the icon alpha moved 3 % down and right, Gaussian-blurred (sigma 2 % of the side, about 4 % across), black at 0.3 (0.4 measured 9.9 codes deep, the source 6.7), baked into the files by finish.mjs; sizes are shares of the icon side

lightsNote: key:fill 3:1 (8.8 : 2.9), as the source icons keep dark shadow sides
